project.title: These Bears Just Flipped Bullish
project.story_thesis: Both published bearish top-or-correction frameworks around the 2025 high, then Bitcoin sold off toward $60K. Krown called $60K major long-term value in February but stayed downside-biased through H1, set a below-$70K buy plan in May, then disclosed low-$60K Bitcoin buys in July and expected no new lows in August. Cowen sold in 2025, still called June the final bear-market stage, then began buying below $60K while still allowing a lower final bottom.
